messages:
elaine: Starting slice deploy for sprint-46 feature flags at 09:30 PT (in ~10m). I'm doing the push to canary-1. Need smoke checks + rollback readiness. @sre_jun, can you and @kai watch metrics? :eyes:
sre_jun: On it. I'll watch p50/p95, error-rate, and token throughput. Will post quick checklist when canary is up.
kai: I'll keep an eye on routing and cache warmup. If latency > 150ms for > 1m I call rollback. :thumbsup:
elaine: Deploy command: `./scripts/deploy --slice s46 --to canary-1 --image redwood/inference:2026-03-s46`
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Build 2026-03-s46 pushed to canary-1, starting rollout (1/3).
maria: Quick FYI: I added a golden prompt smoke job -> `ci/smoke/golden_prompt.yml` runs against canary. Will ping results.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout 1/3 -> 2/3 done. Healthchecks: OK. KV cache primed.
sre_jun: Smoke checklist I ran: 
- simple gen 1 request -> 200
- streaming start within 120ms
- p50 token latency <= 60ms
- error-rate < 0.5%
All green on those. Posting small excerpts:
```
response.status: 200
latency_start_ms: 98
errors_in_1000: 2
```
kai: Routing looks good. No spike in 10m-aggregator. Cache hit ~72% after priming.
elaine: Thanks — rolling rest. If we see any model OOMs call it. Plan B = pin previous image `2026-02-stable` and rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout 3/3 complete. Healthchecks OK. Canary tag: canary-1 -> ready.
dev_manager: @elaine @sre_jun quick note: if anything needs a hotfix, tag `hotfix/s46` and I'll triage PR reviews.
maria: Golden prompt run: 3/3 passed. Sample diff small: minor formatting change in explanation, quality OK.
kai: Monitoring: p95 latency bumped to 170ms for ~30s during a warm window, then settled to 95ms. Watching.
sre_jun: Agree still within acceptable SLO for canary. I'll promote to slice after 10m stable if no new errors.
elaine: Okay I'll start promotion at +12m. Everyone standby for a final smoke ping. :rocket:
sre_jun: Final check at +12: p50 62ms, p95 110ms, error-rate 0.15%. Marking stable.
elaine: Promote done. Notifying release notes and support. Thanks all.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Tagging release `s46-rollout-2026-03-3250019876`
